svg.title: Kadane's algorithm traced day by day
svg.desc: For each day 0 to 7: pnl 3 -5 4 -1 2 6 -9 5; cur in 0 3 -2 4 3 5 11 2; action extend on every day except a reset on day 2; lo 0 0 2 2 2 2 2 2; cur out 3 -2 4 3 5 11 2 7; best 3 3 4 4 5 11 11 11; best range 0-0 0-0 2-2 2-2 2-4 2-5 2-5 2-5. The best stretch is days 2 to 5, total 4 - 1 + 2 + 6 = 11.
